org.primer.llm.usage: Tier-1 layout max-width primitive scale. Has no design meaning of its own, only its position in the ramp — consumed exclusively through tier-2 semantic aliases (theme.*). Do not read one of these directly from component code. layout.scss now reads the tier-2 theme.layout.max-width alias directly (fixed this session — was previously a tier bypass reading these tier-1 pixels straight).
